sloka: विधूतवर्मा नाराचैर्बभूव स कृतव्रणः।इन्द्रजित् समरे वीरः प्ररूढ इव सानुमान् ।। ६.८९.२० ।।
transliteration: vidhūtavarmā nārācairbabhūva sa kṛtavraṇaḥ।indrajit samare vīraḥ prarūḍha iva sānumān ।। 6.89.20 ।।

translations.english: Shattered by the arrows, the shield of Indrajith covered with gold dropped in the chariot like a mass of stars from the sky.
